description:
## Root Cause
When the central Dolt (port 3307, data-dir .dolt-data) goes down (e.g. from SIGQUIT goroutine dump), rig-local bd idle-monitors immediately start their own local Dolt servers at port 3307, squashing the central Dolt.

## Why
- Rigs like beerai, agent_learn have metadata.json with dolt_server_port: 3307
- The bd idle-monitor reads this port and starts a local Dolt at port 3307 when it detects the server is down
- When gt dolt start runs, it finds port 3307 occupied by the impostor and updates its PID file to match — never starting the real central Dolt
- gt dolt status reports all 5 databases as healthy (reads from .dolt-data config) while the actual server on port 3307 has 0 of those databases

## Symptoms
- gt reaper scan --db=beerai returns 'Error 1049: database not found: beerai'
- gt reaper databases returns only 1-2 databases instead of 5
- gt dolt status looks healthy (false positive)

## Immediate Workaround (current session)
1. Stop GT daemon (gt daemon stop) to prevent respawn
2. Kill tmux agent-witness and agent-refinery sessions that trigger bd calls
3. Kill all idle-monitors fighting for port 3307
4. Quickly start central Dolt before any bd command can grab the port
5. Restart daemon

## Underlying Bug
The bd idle-monitor should check whether the server at dolt_server_port is already running BEFORE starting a local one. If port 3307 already has a Dolt server with the expected databases, the idle-monitor should NOT start a competing local server.

Alternatively, bd needs a dolt_external: true metadata flag to suppress local server management for rigs that use a shared central Dolt.
title: Rig local Dolt idle-monitors squash central Dolt on port 3307 when central restarts

description:
## Bug: Central Dolt circuit breaker trips under concurrent polecat load

**Symptom:** When 6-9 polecats are active simultaneously, the bd client circuit breaker trips with 'database not found: <rig>' errors, even though gt dolt status shows all databases healthy. Affects: bd commands, gt mail (messages lost), reaper scans, overseer monitoring.

**Frequency:** Multiple times per session. Recovers on its own after cooldown, or faster with gt dolt stop && gt dolt start.

**Impact:**
- Mail messages to mayor are silently lost (Dolt write fails during circuit open)
- Overseer/reaper scan failures cause false HIGH escalations
- bd commands fail with circuit breaker errors requiring workarounds

**Hypothesis:** The circuit breaker probe threshold is too sensitive for burst concurrent connections from many simultaneous polecats. Single failed query trips the breaker for all clients.

**Workaround:** gt dolt stop && gt dolt start resets the breaker. Wait 10s for cooldown.

**Fix direction:** Raise circuit breaker failure threshold, or use separate connection pools per rig, or investigate why central Dolt fails to respond to specific DB queries under load.

**Related:** gt-ville-zls (hook dispatch bug), recurring overseer HIGH escalations about Dolt.
title: Dolt circuit breaker trips under polecat load — transient 'database not found' errors

description:
## Bug: Polecats spawn but don't pick up hooked work + no completion mail

### Issue 1: Polecats spawn idle
**Symptom:** `gt sling` spawns polecat, attaches molecule to hook, starts tmux session — but the polecat sits idle at the Claude Code prompt. It never runs `gt prime` or checks its hook autonomously.

**Workaround:** After slinging, immediately nudge all polecats:
```bash
gt nudge --mode=immediate <rig>/<polecat> "You have work on your hook. Run: gt prime"
```

### Issue 2: No completion mail to mayor
**Symptom:** Polecats complete work, refineries merge to main, beads get closed — but the mayor never receives mail notification. The only way to discover completion is to manually check bead status or git log.

**Scope:** 100% reproduction rate across all rigs (agent_trade, new_eleusis, beerai). Observed across multiple sling batches on 2026-03-08.

**Previous issues:** gt-ville-u5u, gt-ville-8si (both closed prematurely — bug is NOT fixed).

**Root cause hypothesis:**
1. Polecat session starts but startup hook/CLAUDE.md injection that triggers `gt prime` / `gt hook` isn't firing
2. Witness/polecat completion flow doesn't send mail to mayor — may be a missing notification step in the `gt done` or refinery merge path

**Investigation pointers:**
- `sling.go` — session start logic
- Polecat CLAUDE.md / startup hook injection
- `molecule_status.go` / `beads_redirect.go`
- Witness notification logic on polecat completion
- Refinery merge completion hooks

**This is a gastown infra bug.** File the fix in the gastown rig when ready to work it.
title: Hook dispatch bug: polecats spawn idle, require manual nudge to start work

description: internal/config/types.go line 1227 hardcodes TestCommand to 'go test ./...' in DefaultMergeQueueConfig(). This means any non-Go rig that doesn't explicitly override settings gets a test command that silently does nothing useful. The default should be empty string so that rigs are required to configure their own test_command, or at minimum so the refinery can detect unconfigured rigs.
title: DefaultMergeQueueConfig defaults TestCommand to 'go test ./...' — should be empty
